title: Save toast shows the notice a hook or flow attached to the save
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ the console half of #28000, whose contract half lands in PR #28247 (os-dev-report 6531067088; contract review 6531609713 PASS). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: any app whose save sets something in motion the user should hear about (HotCRM: a deal sent for approval on save, #27380 row 3).

## Observed (once PR #28247 is on `main`)

- The single-record create / update answer carries an optional `notice` string (info severity, distinct from `warnings`); `@objectstack/client` mirrors it. No console surface reads it.

## Wanted

- The save toast shows `notice` with, or in place of, the record-named message: AppContent `crud_success`, `RecordFormPage`, and the inline edit save. Test plus ablation.
- Contract review should-fix (b): decide one toast per write (following #27380 row 2's one-toast rule) and name in the PR which surfaces show it.

Dedupe words: save toast message from hook, notice toast, write answer notice console.

Links back: #28000, PR #28247, #27380.

Blocked-by: #28247
